packages.name: @tsclang/desktop
packages.description: Desktop reference platform: clang build-and-run (isolated clang/LLVM bundles for Windows, Linux and macOS arm64; darwin-x64 -> Xcode CLT; #282)

packages.name: @tsclang/avr
packages.description: AVR microcontroller platform: avr-gcc hex/flash + avrdude (isolated bundles cover Windows, Linux and macOS arm64; #282: system never scanned)

packages.name: @tsclang/wasm
packages.description: WebAssembly bare platform (runtime_wasm.h, emscripten): wasm32, no POSIX; emcc bundles cover Windows, Linux and macOS x64/arm64

packages.name: @tsclang/android
packages.description: Android platform (bionic, API 24+): NDK clang cross-compile — PIE binary and .so; ndk-clang ships as a repacked official NDK bundle (win32-x64 published, posix bundles rolling out via platform-android CI)

packages.name: @tsclang/ios
packages.description: Apple iOS platform: Xcode clang via xcrun, simulator binaries run on the macOS host; no toolchain bundle — Xcode Command Line Tools ARE the toolchain (instruction mode)
